# Executive Summary


---


```{r}
df <- read.csv("protests.csv")

# DO NOT rename columns blindly — use original structure
df$WEEK <- as.character(df$WEEK)
df$WEEK <- lubridate::dmy(trimws(df$WEEK))

df$YEAR <- year(df$WEEK)

df$EVENT_TYPE <- trimws(df$EVENT_TYPE)
df$REGION <- trimws(df$REGION)

middle_east <- df %>%
  filter(REGION == "Northern Africa" | REGION == "Middle East")
```

---

# Countries with Highest Protest Activity

```{r}
middle_east %>%
  filter(EVENT_TYPE == "Protests") %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_events)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(COUNTRY, total_events), total_events)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3498DB") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Countries by Protest Activity",
    x = "",
    y = "Total Events"
  )
```

This chart shows which countries experienced the most protest activity.
